name: mesa-y-evento
description: Mesa & Evento — reservas del restaurante, empaquetada para Android con Capacitor

scripts.android:sync: npm run sync:www && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
